name: Savage Attacker
summary: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll its damage dice twice and use either result.

benefits.name: Savage Attacker
benefits.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll.
benefits.text: Once per turn, when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either of the two rolls against the target.
